settings.content: How to choose the perfect engagement ring

settings.heading: Where to Begin
settings.body:
Buying an engagement ring is one of the most meaningful purchases you will ever make: a symbol of commitment, a keepsake worn every day for decades. It is no wonder so many people feel a quiet anxiety about getting it right.

The good news is that choosing well is not about having an expert's eye or an unlimited budget. It is about understanding what matters, what really does not, and listening closely to what your partner loves.

This guide walks through every step, from your first thoughts on budget to the moment you slip it onto their finger, without the overwhelm, jargon or pressure. Read it in order, or jump to whichever question you actually have.

settings.heading: 15 Chapters
settings.intro: Read in order, or jump to whichever question you have.

settings.heading: Revisit their style
settings.body: What they wear, what they save, what they admire out loud. Go back to it as often as you need.

settings.heading: Define your priorities
settings.body: Size, brilliance, metal, setting. Decide which one you will not compromise on, and which will give.

settings.heading: Choose a jeweller who listens
settings.body: Before they sell. If the first conversation is about what is in stock rather than what you want, that tells you something.

settings.heading: Plan the timeline backwards
settings.body: From your proposal date, and add two weeks of breathing room. At least five weeks is ideal for anything bespoke.

settings.heading: Insure it the day it arrives
settings.body: As a specifically named item, not under general contents. A ring left uninsured is a ring you can lose twice.

settings.heading: Do not rush the final step
settings.body: Give yourself a day or two of reflection before committing. Nothing good is lost by waiting forty-eight hours.
